get.summary: List immediate folders on the backend host
get.description: Authenticated, read-only folder selection. Omit path to start in the parent of the current workspace. Does not import files, recurse or open a project. Use the existing POST /project/open to confirm selection.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute native path accessible to the backend; symbolic-link directories are rejected.

200.description: The selected folder, its parent and immediate real subdirectories.

403.description: A file or symbolic link was selected.

409.description: Folder identity changed during the read.

Path.description: Sciezka wzgledna POSIX w root. Walidacja filesystemu, junction, ADS i nazw urzadzen jest dodatkowo obowiazkowa.

CoachDecision.description: Wynik modelu. Backend dodatkowo sprawdza swiezosc, dozwolone pliki, zgody i stan sesji.
